_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-18 slate (Taipei 09-19). Eighteenth slate of the prospective test. Fourteen of the fifteen games on the US card; Mariners at Rockies is on the card but not this board. One reading conflict: Twins at Angels is corrected to Minnesota. I read the 0-95 handicap on the Angels' row, but the market has Minnesota at 0.5111 with none of fourteen books putting the Angels above even money, so the moneyline decides and the Angels are recorded as the alternative reading. That game also shows the row mismatch withdrawn as a tell on 09-11 -- full game on the Angels, first half on Minnesota -- which is recorded and still not used. The board's own moneyline column is shown in nine games and agrees with the market in all nine. Of the five without it, four match my reading on the market alone: Mets 0.5108 with eleven of eleven above even, Braves 0.4771 home with none above, Yankees 0.4823 home with none above, and Nationals at a dead 0.5000 median with three books above and five below, which is the thinnest call on the board and agrees with my row only barely. Blue Jays at Rangers is the only split total price, again with the over cheaper: 0.950 over, 0.930 under. Handicaps flat at 0.950; every other total flat at 0.940.
